o.text: Morphologically üç + -üncü. Cognate with Kazakh үшінші (üšinši), Old Turkic 𐰇𐰲𐰨 (üčünč), Turkish üçüncü, Turkmen üçünji.
From Proto-Turkic *būg (“steam, fog”). Unrelated to Azerbaijani buxar (“steam”).
From Arabic صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ (ṣallā llāhu ʕalayhi wa-sallama).
